subject: general
question: According to Nitin Gadkari (4th International BBB Summit and Expo on Bioenergy Value Chain in New Delhi), what is India's current rank in global vehicle manufacturing?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Third**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• India now Third largest vehicle manufacturer: Union Minister Nitin Gadkari.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**India is now the ****Third****-largest vehicle manufacturer in the world**, as per Union Minister **Nitin Gadkari**.

 
 
• 
 
He made the remarks at the **4th International BBB Summit and Expo on Bioenergy Value Chain** in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The summit focuses on **promoting technologies** that use **India’s biomass resources**.

 
 
• 
 
The **automobile industry** in India is **constantly growing**.
